As a former prosecutor, I know we need to root out fraud and hold people accountable. As governor, I will order a top-to-bottom audit of our state agencies, strengthen criminal penalties, and increase in-person inspections. And that’s just the start.

Across Minnesota, gas prices are over $4 a gallon. Americans are already dealing with high everyday costs, and this administration’s unilateral war with Iran is only making it worse — and it has to stop.

Video

Minnesotans are right to be angry about fraud. It is unacceptable and it must end. 

As governor, I will strengthen criminal penalties and launch a top to bottom audit of state government to root out waste, fraud, and abuse. Learn about my plan here: amyklobuchar.com/my-plan

Wow! Wolves with an incredible win in San Antonio! The toughness and grit of Anthony Edwards and the entire team makes Minnesota proud. Let's go Wolves!

Every year, I visit all 87 counties. I build coalitions with proven housing leaders like former St. Paul Mayor Chris Coleman and people from across Minnesota to get things done. That's what we need to build more homes so that we can make housing more affordable.

Video

I will show up for every Minnesotan — whether you're a Republican, Democrat, or Independent. Will work with solution-focused mayors like Hollies Winston of Brooklyn Park to deliver results from fixing roads to public safety. Meant a lot to have him there when I laid out my plan to reform state government.

Video

Breaking good news: The Supreme Court just restored access to mifepristone via mail, pharmacy and telehealth. But remember it is simply temporary and the fight to restore a woman’s right to health care access continues state-by-state and on the national level.

When it comes to housing, healthcare, and child care one size doesn’t fit all across our state. I'm grateful to have the support of Greater Minnesota leaders like Grand Rapids Mayor Tasha Connelly and honored she joined us when I laid out my plan to reform our state government.

Video

As the former U.S. Attorney for Minnesota, Andy Luger exposed the fraud and indicted over 70 people. He and I worked together to make sure he had the prosecutors he needed to take these cases on, and I’m honored to have his support.

Video

Minnesotans are right to have high expectations of our government.

Video

Today I announced my plan to transform Minnesota’s government and make it more innovative, effective, and accountable.

Fixing the government is the foundation for everything else. And there’s more to come. Together, we can get it done.

Thank you to former US Attorney Andy Luger, Grand Rapids Mayor Tasha Connelly, Brooklyn Park Mayor Hollies Winston, labor leaders, and small business owners from across the state for joining this campaign to build a better future for Minnesota.

Read my plan her

An incredible tribute to my former staff member Asal Sayas. Even in the face of a cancer diagnosis, she worked tirelessly for more federal research dollars and earlier diagnoses to combat the rise of this disease. She made a real difference and never stopped fighting for others.

washingtonpost.com/obituarie…

Belinda Jensen has been a trusted voice at KARE 11 for more than 30 years. Whether tracking storms or answering gardening questions, she connected with people in a special way. Thank you, Belinda — wishing you the best!

kare11.com/article/news/loca…

Just left a beautiful service filled with community members in New Ulm honoring the memory of Captain Bill Bianchi. A recipient of the Medal of Honor during World War II, Captain Bianchi was killed in action in 1945 at just 29 years old. His remains were only just identified last August and his family kept his memory alive all those years. May he rest in peace.

Rising prices driven by tariffs and a war in Iran are hitting farmers hard as planting season gets underway. We need to change course.

axios.com/local/twin-cities/…

A Louisiana federal court just blocked access to mifepristone by mail, limiting how patients can receive an FDA-approved medication. This decision creates new barriers to care. We must restore women’s access to health care.

Little Joy Coffee in Northfield created a raspberry Danish latte so good it’s gone global, keeping with Minnesota’s long tradition of innovation!

Owner Cody Larson shared the recipe online and now it's in cafes around the world.

cnn.com/travel/raspberry-dan…

Wishing Steve Karnowski the best in his next chapter as he steps away from an incredible career at the Associated Press. He has covered Minnesota for more than 30 years and provided steady, trusted coverage through it all.
